articleTitle: The research of modern stream ciphers
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Synchronous stream ciphers produce long keystreams to be XORed with plaintext. The output keystreams should be indistinguishable from truly random sequences and should not leak any information about the secret key and the internal state of the cipher. In this study, we analyze of modern stream ciphers according to various criteria using methodology eSTREAM.

articleTitle: Analysis of block symmetric algorithms from international standard of lightweight cryptography ISO/IEC 29192-2
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper displays the results of the research of lightweight symmetric cryptographic transformations that can be applied in confined environments. For this purpose, we carried out the analysis and comparative study of such lightweight ciphers with the most common cryptographic algorithm AES, which standardized at the international and national levels, and also we assess the statistical properties and speed.

articleTitle: Robustness evaluation of differential spectrum of integration computational algorithms
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The impact estimates of real numbers representation inaccuracy in ECM with floating point computations on T-spectrum recurrent calculation inaccuracy of homogenous system of common linear differential equations with constant coefficients are obtained.

articleTitle: Construction of cascade codes in the frequency domain
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The mathematical apparatus of the multidimensional discrete Fourier transform over finite fields is considered. Methods for the description of linear block codes in the frequency domain are investigated. It is shown that, in contrast to iterative codes (code-products), cascade codes in the general case cannot be described in the frequency domain in terms of multidimensional spectra. Analytic expressions are obtained that establish a one-to-one functional correspondence between the spectrum of a sequence over a finite field and the spectra of the corresponding words obtained by limiting this word to a subfield. A general solution of the problem of representation of cascade codes in the frequency domain is obtained, which allows constructing in the frequency domain using computationally efficient algorithms of encoding and decoding, and the derived analytic dependences of components of multidimensional spectra.

Author Keywords: multidimensional discrete Fourier transform over finite fields
efficient algorithms of encoding and decoding

articleTitle: Algorithm for clusterization, aggregation and prioritization of M2M devices in heterogeneous 4G/5G network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper we propose algorithm for clustering, aggregation and classification of M2M devices in future 4G/5G networks. The proposed algorithm ensures more efficient use of the radio resourse of the mobile network, reduction of the signal load to the base station and the power consumption of M2M devices. The novelty of the algorithm lies in choosing the main mobile node based on the Voronoi diagram and the methods of fuzzy logic. This algorithm is implemented on new M2M gateways, which will perform the functions of selecting the main node, grouping various data into service classes, and balancing the load between the gateways in order to transfer data to non-loadbearing base stations 4G/5G.

articleTitle: Periodic characteristics of output feedback encryption mode
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: We investigate periodic characteristics of sequence of output blocks in the output feedback encryption mode. The model of random homogeneous substitution is used for an abstract description of this formation. This property is directly related to the periodic properties of output feedback encryption mode, since it characterizes the probabilistic distribution of output blocks with certain period appearance, provided that the assumption is made that the properties of the block symmetric cipher are consistent with certain properties of the random substitution. Also in the work specific practical tasks are solved, namely recommendations are being developed for the application of the outbound feedback on the encryption threshold, certain requirements and limitations are justified.

Author Keywords: periodic characteristics of sequence of output blocks

articleTitle: Analysis of the impact of the slow HTTP DOS and DDOS attacks on the cloud environment
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Denial of service (DOS) attack is an attack which the attacker or attackers make an effort to make a service or resources out of access. If attackers want to intensify the power of the attack or stay undetected they might use Distributed DOS (DDOS) methods. Application layer DOS (ADOS) attacks are exploiting a flaw in a software, therefore they need fewer resources on the attacker side, hard to detect and also stronger hardware on the victim side doesn't guarantee the attack failed. Slow HTTP attacks are ADOS attack in which they take advantage of the architecture of HTTP protocol connection's mechanism and target the vulnerable web servers. There has been much research about ways to prevent the Slow HTTP DOS attacks, but none of these studies have considered the impact of such DOS and DDOS attack on the virtual environment which is the core of cloud computing. One of the main question that this paper is trying to solve is, what impacts Slow HTTP DOS and DDOS can cause on a virtual machine (VM) also on the neighbor VM, In this paper, we demonstrate and analyze the direct and indirect impact of the slow HTTP DOS and DDOS on the virtual environment. we will launch the Slowloris DOS and DDOS on VMs and analyze the direct impact of the attack on the target VM also the indirect impact of the attack on the neighbor VM.

articleTitle: Method coding efficiency segments for information technology processing video
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: It has been shown that to ensure a compromise between the intensity of the video information and its integrity is required to further improve the stream data frames processing techniques. Necessity method of constructing effective syntactic encoding predicted frames based on the identification packed two-dimensional spectral space structural transformants. Developed efficient syntactic representation of video segments based on object-dimensional positional coding transformant in a packed two-dimensional space with the structural syndrome availability paired inequalities elements.

articleTitle: Fractal time series analysis of social network activities
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the work, a comparative correlation and fractal analysis of time series of Bitcoin crypto currency rate and community activities in social networks associated with Bitcoin was conducted. A significant correlation between the Bitcoin rate and the community activities was detected. Time series fractal analysis indicated the presence of self-similar and multifractal properties. The results of researches showed that the series having a strong correlation dependence have a similar multifractal structure.

articleTitle: Method for adaptive client oriented management of quality of service in integrated SDN/CLOUD networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The main idea and novelty of the work is the proposed integrated SDN/CLOUD network, which allows end users to request end-to-end service quality for any service at a specific time. In this paper, we propose the method of adaptive client-oriented quality management of services in the integrated network by monitoring the QoS parameters, prioritizing according to QoE requirements and balancing the load in the SDN and CLOUD plane. Generally, network scanning allows to periodically receiving information about the quality of the transmitted flows, the state of the nodes and servers for adaptive setup. If a malfunction occurs at the service level, the physical devices can be automatically merged to locate the malfunction and vice versa, if the problem is overloading the SDN switch, then it takes place through a less loaded node with QoS provisioning.

articleTitle: Two-level method of fast ReRouting in software-defined networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A two-level method of Fast ReRouting in Software-Defined Networks is proposed. The novelty of the method is consists of the introduction of a two-level hierarchy of calculating the routing variables responsible for the formation of the primary and backup paths and ensuring a balanced load of the network links, which meets the requirements of the Traffic Engineering concept. The method provides implementation of the path and bandwidth protection scheme for Fast ReRouting. Within the framework of the proposed method, the two-level hierarchy of calculations introduced in accordance with the interaction prediction principle of the theory of hierarchical multi-level systems. The analysis of the proposed two-level method confirmed its functionality and efficiency from the point of view of obtaining optimal solutions for ensuring balanced load of communication links and implementing the required network element protection schemes for Fast ReRouting in SDN.

articleTitle: The building of a security strategy based on the model of game management
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Cyber security management of systems in the cyberspace has been a challenging problem for both practitioners and the research community. Their proprietary nature along with the complexity renders traditional approaches rather insufficient and creating the need for the adoption of a holistic point of view. This paper draws upon the principles theory game in order to present a novel systemic approach towards cyber security management, taking into account the complex inter-dependencies and providing cost-efficient defense solutions.

articleTitle: The method of the scientific directions potential forecasting in infocommunication systems of an assessment of the research activity results
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The method of the scientific directions potential forecasting in Infocommunication systems of an assessment of the research activity results is described. Formulas for calculation of forecasting for the partition of the set of scientific directions are given. Also assessments of scientific activity of scientists for previous periods are taken into account in the calculation. Linearly-weighed moving average model is applied to create the forecast of potential of the scientific directions. The method can be used for identification of the perspective directions of researches, which are formed in the scientific environment.

Author Keywords: assessment of the research activity results

articleTitle: Distributed local positioning system using DWM1000 location chip
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this work we developed and investigated an indoor positioning system using radio module DWM1000, methods and algorithms for it and did an experimental test of the developed system accuracy. The test results showed that it is necessary to calibrate the system. After the calibration, the accuracy of the distance determination was within 10-20 cm.

articleTitle: Remote control systems of household appliances
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted to the description of the basic technologies of the smart home system. Connections of elements with the main module are described. Considered IR protocol, Bluetooth and SPI interface. Indicated the list of sensors and detectors that is uses.

articleTitle: Features of the use of software packages for modeling infocommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper presented a mathematical model of interacting TCP-connections in the form of an ensemble of nonlinear mathematical pendulums, in which each TCP connection acts as a pendulum.

articleTitle: Scheme for dynamic channel allocation with interference reduction in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper introduces a new scheme of dynamic interference free channel allocation. The scheme is based on additional spectral analyzers in wireless networks IEEE 802.11. Design and implementation is presented.

articleTitle: Method for calculating of R-learning traffic peakedness
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this article e-leaming traffic which is served by system on the hyper convergent platform is considered. It was done the analysis of the known methods of determine the degree of pulsation of traffic. The method for calculating of e-learning traffic peakedness is proposed. Simulation and calculation results peakedness is analyzed.

articleTitle: Chua's circuits interval synchronization
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The secure data transmission is one of the chaotic systems usages. The paper deals with the construction of interval controllers for the slave Chua's circuit. Such controller allows for everybody to perform two Chua's circuit synchronization with high precision. Mentioned precision is achieved by forming control signal for slave Chua's circuit on the basis of maximal and minimal values of state variables. High precision synchronization is granted by proposed method. Due to this method we transform mathematical description of Chua's circuit into Brunovsky form at first. Then we defined control signal for already transformed object. At last we transform defined in such way control signal into voltage source electro-motion force. When this transformation is performed 2-nd order sliding mode in closed loop system is appeared. So proposed control system has invariant property to parameters changing. We show benefits of proposed method for Chua's circuit synchronization by various state variables. Simulation results allow us to claim that proposed approach for setting up master-slave synchronization of Chua's circuits can be useful for couple of Chua's circuit with different parameters and initial conditions.

articleTitle: Salivary lipid peroxidation and periodontal status detection in ukrainian atopic children with convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The aim of this work was to build information model of salivary lipid peroxidation and periodontal status and to evaluate the correlation between antioxidant level in unstimulated saliva of children and inflammation in periodontal tissues. The study was conducted on 141 subjects, which were in the age group of 12-18 years reporting to the Department of Pediatric Dentistry. Among the 141 subjects, 55 healthy controls (HC) formed. The atopy group consisted of 126 patients with the following conditions: 76 patients of atopic diseases and gingivitis and 50 patients of atopic diseases without clinical manifestations of gingivitis. The obtained data prove that there is an oxidative misbalance in children with atopy. Level of MDA is increased and level of glutathione is decreased in group of patients with atopy and it does not depend on the presence of gingivitis in these groups. The information model of salivary lipid peroxidation, periodontal status was built and regression analysis showed that there was no correlation between inflammation in periodontal tissues and level of antioxidants.

articleTitle: Optimization of QoS chracteristics of self-similar traffic
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The work considers the optimization task for QoS characteristic of self-similar traffic with the Weibull distribution in the case of a W/M/1 queuing system. The maximum and minimum values of the quality of service characteristics have been obtained for self-similar traffic serviced by the W/M/1 queuing system. These include the average delay time for packets in different conditions of the QS operation.

articleTitle: Conditional average value of queues in queuing systems with bath request flows
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article describes queuing systems (QS) with batch request flows, typical for modern multiservice telecommunication networks. It contains generalization of Pollaczek-Khinchin formula for systems with common type flows. We have examined the dependencies of mean queue size at low duty ratio. We have introduced the concept of conditional mean queue size, which is a mean provided that an intervals of processor downtime are absent. We propose algorithm of approximation dependencies queues size in queuing systems with batch requests flows. We consider time delay in queues. We set the ultimate load levels which provide the established queue sizes and time delays.

articleTitle: Determination of the not uniformity of illumination in process monitoring of wheat crops by UAVs
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article proposes a new method of identification of images with not uniformity illumination from natural objects. The technique uses a combination of image transformations and the neural network that performs the classification of images and can be used in real-time.

articleTitle: Simulation of telecommunication traffic using statistical models of fractional Brownian motion
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this work, we investigate the properties of the computer network traffic based on statistical models of fractional Brownian motion. A comparison of different simulation methods of fractional Brownian motion and estimating methods for Hurst index according to the modeling results done in the work.

Author Keywords: accuracy and reliability of the model

articleTitle: Interaction model design of ZigBee-gateway between wireless sensor network and industrial network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In article present the communication model between ZigBee network and industrial network. The limitations of the industrial network are analyzed. Presented possible software and hardware solutions of ZigBee-gateway.

articleTitle: Post quantum hash based digital signatures comparative analysis. Features of their implementation and using in public key infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper contains the results of perspective digital signatures algorithms based on hash functions analysis. Several aspects of their implementation are presented. The comparative analysis was carried out by the method of hierarchies. Some problems of implementation in the existing infrastructure are described. XMSS algorithm implementation with Ukrainian hash function national standard is presented.

articleTitle: An improved method for segmentation of a multiscale sequence of optoelectronic images
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: It was done the analysis of the known methods of segmenting images which obtained from the board of the optoelectronic surveillance. It has been established the basic disadvantages inherent in the classical methods of the image segmentation with specific imaging in airborne optoelectronic observation. It was suggested at the segmentation of the optoelectronic images to conduct their multiple transformations previously. Gaussians was selected with the appropriate scale factor values as a core transformation. The using of the evolutionary method proposed in a method of the segmentation. Experimental study on segmentation of multiple sequence of the optoelectronic image were conducted by evolutionary method.

articleTitle: Adaptation to observation conditions in television systems by means of signal correction
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The analysis of works devoted to the construction of adaptive television and multimedia systems is carried out. The classification of models of color perception and their evolutionary series is presented. An embodiment of an adaptive digital television or multimedia system is considered. The influence of adapting conditions on the image, their variation and possible correction options on the transmitting and receiving sides is shown. A variant of the values of the color bars signals in a system with an extended dynamic range of brightness is proposed. Proposals are given on colorimetric estimates of the proposed options for the implementation of systems, as well as promising ways of developing adaptive television and multimedia systems.

articleTitle: Game theoretical framework for multi-operator spectrum sharing in 5G heterogeneous networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Spectrum scarcity is one of the most important problems in modern mobile networks. In order to satisfy continuously increasing traffic demands, new approaches are needed to improve the efficiency of spectrum utilization in mobile networks. One of the promising solutions is spectrum sharing that allows multiple operators to use the same spectrum bands in an opportunistic manner. In this paper, we propose a new game theoretical framework for multioperator spectrum sharing in 5G heterogeneous networks. The novelty of this approach is that it takes into account both licensed and unlicensed spectrum bands. This feature allows multiple network operators to utilize unlicensed spectrum opportunistically while keeping the fair coexistence with WiFi networks. Simulations results show that using the proposed framework all competing operators achieve better performance, comparing to conventional spectrum sharing solutions.

articleTitle: Increase the speed of detection and recognition of computer attacks in combined diagonalized neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method increase the speed of detection and recognition of computer attacks using diagonalization matrices of synaptic connections in series-connected recirculating neural network and multilayer perceptron. It is established that the decrease in the number of weight of synaptic connections between neurons reduces the vulnerability of the combined neural networks of various computer attacks by about 10%. The main advantages of this approach is the ability of the combined diagonalized the neural network to reduce the time of adaptation to dynamic conditions and to increase the speed of its functioning in real time.

articleTitle: Survey of the IoT data transmission protocols
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this article are listed the most popular IoT data transmission protocols and their main features. These protocols are used to create modern IoT projects in startups, scientific projects and other useful devices for a smart house etc. The article formulates a basic review of IoT data transmission protocols based on user needs.

articleTitle: Proactive project management for development of distributed information systems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this article, we will look at proactive management of distributed projects, based on creation and development of distributed information systems. We will unveil the particularities of distributed IT projects as a complex adaptive system that evolves under multiple interrelated constraints.

articleTitle: Algorithms of data processing in the residual classes system
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The coding of remainders number which submitted the appropriate modules of residual classes system (RCS), made with data from complete system of the smallest non-negative residues (CSSNR) was showed in the article. In this aspect, CSSNR is the basis for the construction of nonpositional code structure in RCS. Possible field of science and engineering, where there is an urgent need for fast, reliable, and high-precision integer calculations were clarified and systematized in the paper. On the basis of studies of the properties of RCS were examined the advantages and disadvantages of using modular arithmetic (MA). Using the results of the analysis of problems of integer data and a set of positive attributes of MA, the classes of problems and algorithms, which using RCS, much more efficient binary positional numeral systems were defined in the article.

Author Keywords: complete system of the smallest non-negative residues
computer system and a data processing means which represented in integer form

articleTitle: Construction method and features of one class of cryptographic discrete signals
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This work presents the results of solving the problem of optimizing the time for performing synthesis of subsets of cryptographic discrete signals with given ensemble and correlation properties required for noise-immunity and information security of telecommunication systems. The work deals with the method of generating cryptographic discrete signals based on Golomb's postulates.

Author Keywords: synthesis of nonlinear discrete complex signals

articleTitle: Ethical hacking and penetration testing using raspberry PI
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This document is dedicated to the field of network and info-communication defense along the cyber security platform to take a closer look at what is now known as “ETHICAL HACKING”, in order to define, analyze, discuss and resolve some of the most common and widely spread threats and their functionalities according to which vulnerabilities are currently at hands in most threat incidents and try to come up with new techniques to more effective resolve such problems.

articleTitle: Structural-semantic model of communication channel
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this article, we propose a structurally semantic model that base on using mathematical apparatus of fuzzy logic and allows us to estimate the quality of the communication channel for variety of different evaluation indicators, after which we form a generalized solution about quality.

articleTitle: Block cipher with improved dynamic indicators of the condition of a random substitution
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: On the example of the improved cipher of Kalina-2, SPN ciphers with improved indicators of their transition to the state of random substitution is offering. The improvement is basing on the application of the first cycle transformation of the new design, which allows activating all S-blocks of the second cycle. Ciphers are not inferior to the speed of known structures and allow without reducing the stability to use in them random S-blocks.

Author Keywords: dynamic indexes of cipher transition to random substitution

articleTitle: The information integrity enhance in telecommunication systems with the binomial coding
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article proves the problems of ensuring the integrity for the state video information resource. To counteract cyber attacks, it is proposed to use video encoding. To provide codes positioning it is proposed to use the align redistribution method for statistical codes. The binary elements sequence structural characteristic is taken into account for the fixed length code structures formation. The recovery error localization within the binary elements sequence set is justified. Thus, the proposed method allows the state video information resource integrity increasing.

articleTitle: Open problems of proving security of ARX-based ciphers to differential cryptanalysis
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: There are many ARX-based symmetric primitives that form the core of modern lightweight cryptography. The paper considers the known methods of proving differential properties of ARX-based ciphers based on application of partial difference distribution tables, probabilistic neutral bits and SAT solvers. The known long trail strategy that allows designing provable secure ARX-based block ciphers is also considered. The open problems of proving ARX-ciphers security to differential attacks are formulated. It is underlined that there is no universal theory that allows evaluating security of any ARX-based primitive to differential cryptanalysis.

articleTitle: Productivity of telecommunication systems with modified signal-code constructions
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper represents research results of using modified signal-code constructions productivity with multipositional phase manipulation. The construction peculiarities are considered for coder, decoder and signal processing block with modified construction. The principals for signal processing have been described and the block-scheme of signal processing system for the offered signal-code constructions has been represented. Energy gain coding from using modified code constructions in telecommunication systems has been defined. The recommendations have been given for choosing number of iteration cycles in decoding and the code word construction has been described for coding with noise immunity and error correction.

articleTitle: The concept of elasticity of scale-free networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The concept of elasticity of graphs is presented. Elasticity factor is a scale-free measure of graph density. Scale-free networks model with elasticity factor is proposed. Applying the concept of elasticity, i.e. the concept of different relative growth rates for links and nodes, makes it possible to generate scale-free models for dense networks. Also, the low bound of scaling factor domain of scale-free models is much lower when non-unit elasticity used. This feature expands the scope of scale-free models for networks having Zip's distribution of nodes degree.

articleTitle: Metric tensor definition model for service-oriented network based on curvilinear coordinates systems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper we analyzed definitions of the metric tensor, Christopher's symbols, Riemann and Ricci tensors, scalar curvature of space for different spaces. The component of the metric tensor is determined by using the cosine theorem for a quadrilateral, taking into account the two-way connection between each pair of nodes. We proposed the way to increase the number of components of a metric tensor that will allow to represent a metric in a symmetric tensor space and describe the deformation of the Riemann metric which is used in the Ricci flows.

articleTitle: Determination of expected output signals of the neural network model intended for image recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of further development of the methodology of using neural network models based on a multilayer perceptron for image recognition. It is shown that a significant shortcoming of modern methodologies is the insufficient efficiency of learning neural network models, is associated with the insufficient quality of processing statistical data that are used in the formation of the parameters of the training example. One of the important reasons for this is the lack of correlation between the expected output of the training examples with the closeness of the standards of the classes that should be recognized. It is suggested to improve the quality of the training examples by using the method of neural network coding the magnitude of the expected output signal of the training examples, which will allow taking into account the proximity of the standards of recognized classes in such a signal. A method for determining the encoding of the expected output signal is developed, which provides for estimating the closeness of standards using a probabilistic neural network. The expediency of using a probabilistic neural network is determined on the basis of the low resource intensity of its training. In addition, in the training examples of such a network, the expected output signal can be represented not by a number, but by the name of the expected class. The mathematical apparatus of the method is formed. As a result of numerous experiments it was shown that the application of the developed method makes it possible to reduce the number of training iterations in 1.3-1.5 times to achieve an allowable error of training within 1%. It is shown that the prospects for further research are to adapt the method to neural network systems used in industries in which the computational complexity of learning is of critical importance.

articleTitle: The synthesys of equivalence digital filters for tandem decimation on base I/Q-demodulation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article describes the implementation of methodology for synthesis of equivalent digital filters for tandem decimation on base I/Q-demodulation.

articleTitle: Parametric analysis of galvanostatic type impedance measuring front-end
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The basic approaches of parametric analysis of impedance measuring front-end on the base of SPICE modeling are considered in paper. The method for impedance analysis using the mathematical functions of real Re and imaginary Im signal components is applied. By means of this functions it is possible to investigate the frequency dependences of the corresponding values of the active ReZ and the reactive ImZ impedance, and, thus, to plot the Nyquist diagram. In this article, the galvanostatic measurement method is used, which is on the base of the determination of the ratio and phase delay between the voltage and the harmonic current with the specified amplitude and frequency. As a result of simulation, the possibility of significant increase of the measurement transformation accuracy is found by means of modifying the input circuits of the impedance measuring front-end.

articleTitle: Analysis of methods for assessing the reliability and security of infocommunication network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article considers methods of ensuring reliability and protection of information in infocommunication networks. The work proposes splitting the infocommunication network into several levels and segments, depending on their functional tasks. Due to this distribution, the task of assessing the reliability and security of the network is the calculation of the failure rates not only at one level, but also on each individual segment. Thus, obtaining reliable data of each level is the starting point that will be the basis for assessing the reliability and security of the infocommunication network as a whole.

articleTitle: Regression-based analysis of visual quality for denoised images
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Visual quality plays a key role in different image processing applications, in particular, in image denoising. Assessment of visual quality of denoised images allows assessing the effectiveness of filtering. Among image visual quality assessment approaches, the most reliable are experiments with observers to get mean opinion score (MOS). This paper aims to conduct prediction of MOS for denoised images based on several quantitative criteria. Probability of voting for expedience of denoising is used as MOS. Analysis is carried out for two filters - standard DCT filter and BM3D. Problems and challenges of such prediction are shown.

articleTitle: Applied research of modulation-coding schemes selection algorithms effectiveness in 802.11 equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In modern 802.11 equipment the algorithms are implemented that control MCS (Modulation-Coding Schemes) selection depending on the statistical data of successfully transmitted and lost data packets, without taking into account the energy conditions in the communication channel. In this paper, an applied experiment is performed in point-to-point (PtP) link with the study of the algorithm for MCS switching using the same communication equipment, with manual changing energy conditions in the communication channel. As a result, the correspondence was obtained for the MCS of 802.11n standard and communication channel energy characteristics, what is opposite to the statistical data of transmitted and received packets.

articleTitle: Investigation of simulating methods for self-similar traffic flows: The QoS-characteristics depend on the type of distribution in self-similar traffic
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: To evaluate the quality of service parameters of self-similarity traffic you can use simulation methods. However, the result of this assessment will depend on the chosen modeling method. Since self-similar traffic (time interval between requests) best describes the Weibull or Pareto distribution, it is for him gives investigation. The influence of simulations methods to parameters QoS in conditions of self-similarity traffic flow is probed.

articleTitle: Development of authentication process when accessing cloud services
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Cloud services are a rapidly developing industry, but rapid development is accompanied by many problems. One of such problems is unsafe authentication, which leads to the theft of confidential information. The problem of theft the access to the account is discussed all over the world. In this article, the authentication protocols that are being used, modified and developed by scientists and developers were reviewed. The presence of a large information base indicates that this problem is urgent and requires solutions.

articleTitle: Cipher with improved dynamic indicators of the condition of a random substitution
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Description of a new 256-bit SPN cipher, called a managed substitution cipher (MSC), is present. This is an SPN cipher with a two-layer substitution transformation in the first cycle and one-layer substitution transformations in the remaining cycles. Management of substitution transformations is carried out by including them in a chain so that the value of the output of the previous SL transformation is fed to the input of the current enlarged 32-bit substitution transformation (SL transformation) along with the current value of the input data block through the adder modulo 2. It is show that such a construction of the ciphered function of the cipher allows us to reduce the minimum number of cycles of its arrival to the state of random substitution. This in turn reduces the number of encryption cycles (to increase the speed) and create the conditions under which S-blocks of random type can be used in the cipher without sacrificing security.

articleTitle: Analysis of wireless sensor networks characteristics
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper discusses key features and implementation options for wireless sensor networks (WSNs) based on the IEEE 802.15.4/ZigBee standard. The results of simulation modeling of this network are presented; this was carried out for the purpose of determining the characteristics of the functioning of the WSNs for several topology variants. The results show that the cluster tree topology has a higher energy efficiency than other topologies (star, mesh), but is characterized by a low quality of service (QoS). In order to improve the QoS parameters, a new approach based on time scheduling is suggested.

articleTitle: Hierarchical method of load-balancing routing in MPLS network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper hierarchical method of loadbalancing routing in MPLS network. Method identified tasks of two hierarchical levels: realization of source routing (lower level) and prevention of link overload in MPLS-network (upper level). Method oriented on procuring of Load-Balancing Routing in MPLS-network on principles of conceptions of Traffic Engineering. Modification of conditions of load balancing of links allows to reduce number of coordination iterations about 2 to 5 times which in practice will lead to a proportional decrease in the amount of service information circulating in the network associated with the implementation of hierarchical routing, as well as to increase the efficiency of network management in general.

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling and computer simulation of direct method for studying boundary value problem of thermal conductivity
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A constructive scheme for studying the distribution of a non-stationary temperature field throughout the thickness of a single-layered plane structure is proposed and substantiated. The basis of this scheme is a direct method of studying boundary value problems of thermal conductivity with piecewise constant coefficients and stationary inhomogeneity. The obtained analytical solution is modeled as a pseudocode on a specific numerical example.

articleTitle: The application of neural networks for the intelligent analysis of multidimensional data
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article discusses the relevance of using neural networks in data mining. First, the method of neural networks described in data mining. We presented data analysis based on artificial neural networks. We describe the use of neural networks and fuzzy Kohonen neural network data mining. That discovered advantages and disadvantages of data networks. Development of database technology and database management systems, promotes the growth of data stored in the database. This data contains a lot of important information that has great potential for increasing profits. Therefore, many companies use the technology of data mining, which can handle multidimensional arrays database and extract from them useful information.

articleTitle: Methods for implementing communications in info-communication systems based on signal structures with specified properties
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The problems of increasing noise immunity (stealth operation of the system, noise immunity of signal reception), information security of information and communication systems (ICS) under the conditions of the influence of many external and internal threats on such systems are considered. It is shown that the solution of this problem is possible on the basis of improving the methodological foundations of ICS construction, by developing methods of information exchange, the synthesis of new classes of nonlinear discrete complex signals with the necessary ensemble, correlation and structural properties. A mathematical formulation and solution of the problem of synthesis of a nonlinear discrete complex signal systems with given ensemble, correlation, and statistical properties is given. The method of synthesis of one class of nonlinear discrete complex signals of cryptographic signals (CS) is presented. The results of the research of the properties of this class of signals are presented. Possible applications of CS in modern information and communication systems.

articleTitle: Improving of photonic crystal fibers connection quality using positioning by the autoconvolution method
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper considers of the tasks of improving of the quality connection of fibers new type - the photonic-crystal fibers. Measurement of the field distribution intensity of photonic crystal fibers under transverse illumination is carried out using the profile alignment system. Subsequent processing of the resulting image by the method of autoconvolution makes it possible to determine with greater accuracy the symmetry center of the photonic-crystal fiber. This improves of the positioning accuracy of the fibers when they are connected.

articleTitle: Nonparametric estimate of multiplicity of the signal phase-shift keying
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The method of estimation of the manipulation multiplicity of MPSK signal using observation of signal in the white noise with an unknown distribution law is considered in the paper. The properties of nonparametric estimate of multiplicity of signal manipulation with using BDS-statistic are studied. The results of the article can be used for automation of the signal monitoring in the case unknown properties of observation noise.

articleTitle: Models of information security risk accounting in metrics of dynamic routing protocols
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the article, it is proposed to improve the formulas for computing metrics of RIP, OSPF and EIGRP routing protocols by introducing an information security risk indicator of the route. This approach will allow to choose the best route in terms of Quality of Service (QoS) indicators and information security (confidentiality, integrity and availability of transmitted information).

articleTitle: Waiting time analysis for the M/G/1 queuing system with correlated traffic
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The waiting time of a request in a queue in the queuing system M/G/1 easily can be found for independent inter-arrival time and service time intervals. In case of a correlation between these sequences, finding the value of the mean waiting time in the queue is complicated due to the fact that to solve the Lindley integral equation it is necessary to know the two-dimensional probability density function. Here shown the way to find this function using a copula.

articleTitle: Lossy compression of hyperspectral images based on JPEG2000
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Lossy compression of images is used in different applications including remote sensing. A problem is how to carry out such lossy compression automatically with providing appropriate quality. This paper deals with considering peculiarities of using JPEG2000-based coders for compressing hyperspectral data. Two approaches - component-wise and 3D are analyzed. It is demonstrated that 3D compression provides better results but both approaches are characterized by the same drawback - it is problematic to provide distortions less or comparable with noise in hyperspectral images.

articleTitle: Formal representation of knowledge for infocommunication computerized training systems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Various questions of creation of integrated development environment for infocommunication training systems are considered in the given paper. The information technologies and algebra of finite predicates that can be used for creating of the integrated development environment are described. Different aspects of minimization of formulas of algebra of finite predicates realization of such systems are analyzed. Some ways to improve the efficiency and quality of learning process with computer training systems for distance education are pointed out.

articleTitle: Information provision for automated production of entomophages
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Information provision of automated production of entomophages is implemented by a computer-integrated control system: the quality of entomophages using intelligent information processing algorithms based on the theory of fuzzy logic; microclimate parameters in the zone of insect breeding (temperature and relative humidity of air, temperature of the nutrient medium with entomocultures) and the quality of entomocultures, technological parameters (energy consumption, gas composition of air, amount and type of nutrient medium, feeding of feed with biological additives, amount of insect-host eggs introduced into the nutrient medium). This information is stored in structured form (Microsoft Office Access Database) and used in the knowledge base (Matlab) to create an intelligent decision making system for the quality of the entomological product.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the two-way time stamps exchange in packet network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper presents the results of two-way network protocols evaluation analysis based on the Time Error (tE) and Time Interval Error (TIE) functions. The two-way time synchronization model that includes random components is proposed. The reason of using of maximum likelihood estimation statistics is analyzed. The results have been confirmed by computer simulation and measurement.

articleTitle: On radar signals analysis using the fractal dimension
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Applicability of the fractal method, one of nonlinear dynamic methods, for radar signal characteristic is studied. The use of the fractal dimension for reflected signal analysis on the entire range interval and moving objects is shown. The impact of signal-to-noise ratio on the fractal dimension values estimated.

articleTitle: Circuit implementation of Lozi ring-coupled map
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this manuscript the circuit implementation of two-dimensional Lozi ring-coupled map for the generator of chaotic signals is proposed. Used chaotic systems are multidimensional maps, that are characterized by a uniform distribution of the generated values, continuous bifurcation diagram, that makes it possible to apply them to information security systems. It is shown that the results of experiment and simulation are agreed.

articleTitle: Sampling for direct search method of all system implementations developed according to the requirements of the technical design specification
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper shows that, despite a huge number of generated system variants while designing, possible variants set on which to find the best variant can be reduced by thousands of times without the risk to lose the desired optimal variant. This turned out to be possible because the full set of the generated system variants was obtained without taking into account the constraints that are laid down in the requirements of the technical design specification (TDS). A set of possible system variants is obtained by taking into account the restrictions that are specified in the TDS. Here the word "possible variants" should be understood as reflecting the requirements of TDS. So in the work of the authors [1] 10800 system variants are reduced to 24 systems that meet the requirements of TDS.

Author Keywords: new objective function of modified direct search method

articleTitle: Adjustement of wavelet function parameters for analysis of non-stationary periodic signals with multistart optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The technique for selecting the length of the wavelet function carrier for determining the coordinates of the extrema of periodic signals is given. This technique is based on multi-start optimization with the wavelet transform. Such an approach makes it possible to increase noise resistance and reduce sensitivity to local extrema of periodic signals. The evaluation of the possibilities of this method was carried out by determining the coordinates of the QRS-complexes of the electrocardiograms. The error in determining the QRS-complexes with an increase in noise level is investigated.

articleTitle: Spatial polarization suppression of active interference in a tropospheric polarization-orthogonal communication channel
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The method of automatic compensation of active noise interference with the use of polarization and spatial differences in signals and interference is considered. The method is based on differences in the polarization and directions of arrival of signals and interference.

articleTitle: Web-based protected geoinformation system of criminal analysis (RICAS) for analytical support for crimes investigation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article is devoted to the problem of appliance of web-based geoinformation tools for improving the effectiveness of information-analitical work in the internal affairs through the creation of intelligent technological tools of the new generation. It has gone the overview of foreign automated information and analytical works, highlighting their strengths and weaknesses. As a solution to the problems set forth proposed to use developed web-oriented protected geoinformation intelligent system of criminal analysis - RICAS for analytical support of crimes investigation. Its purpose, functionality, performance techniques criminal analysis means the system benefits compared with existing analogues and novelty are described.

Author Keywords: the visual analysis of the crime

articleTitle: Estimation and reduction of the climatic conditions influence on the radio signal propagation in the troposphere
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this work are probed weakening of a wireless signal depending on climatic conditions. The choice method of optimal wireless signals parameters for tropospheric radio communication systems of a special purpose was developed. Besides, the developed emitting power regulation method of radio relay tropospheric stations transmitters depending on weather conditions for necessary data transmission rate and stealthiness support of stations was offered.

articleTitle: Multipath routing model of multicast flows in telecommunication networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In order to ensure the optimal load balancing in telecommunications network, the multicast routing flow-based model has been improved in the direction of implementing the multipath packet transmission strategy. It is suggested to split the original multicast flow into a set of subflows, for each of which an optimal tree is built as a multicast route. The problem of multipath multicast routing is presented in an optimization form, contributing to the most effective load balancing in the network. The application of the proposed model of multipath multicast routing allowed to improve the upper threshold of traffic congestion on the average from 17 to 25% compared to a singlepath solution.

articleTitle: Research of tunneling effect in MPLS network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A simulation model of a real network traffic route in NS2 was developed. It provides a methodology for analyzing the efficiency of tunnels in the MPLS network for a section of the real highway. As a result, characteristics of the control algorithms and the load in real-traffic conditions are obtained. The methodology for evaluating the quality of service for traffic in the MPLS network can be used to select efficient network device modes.

articleTitle: Approaches to solving the problem of improving the efficiency of scalable telecommunication platforms
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The thesis is devoted to solving the actual scientific problem of methodological means development for scalable telecommunication service platforms synthesis including the national level for the optimal implementation of the ubiquitous computing concept (distributed computing) with specified levels of quality of service, performance, and functional stability. The methodology and methods were contributed and considered in overall which allow the implementation of the telecommunication service platforms for the optimum technical and economic indicators accomplishment to make process development of e-services distribution and ubiquitous computing means implementation by companies and agencies using open system architecture more efficient and dynamic.

articleTitle: Agent-based modeling of the human behavior with genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article deals with the implementation of the genetic algorithm for training and optimization of the neural network and its application to the tasks related to agent-based modeling of human behavior. After the analysis of existing agent-based modeling programs, several drawbacks were noticed. The main problem of other systems for crowd modeling was the missing of information about the psychoemotional state of people, who are in crowd. According to the other sources, moods in crowd influence its behavior the most. Therefore, we decided to propose another methodic of creating more realistic crowd behavior. The system that implements training of agents by selecting the most effective strategies of behavior from the existing set of strategies using the genetic algorithm was proposed. In addition, this article highlights the detailed development of one agent behavior module based on the neural network, which help the agent to navigate in the environment on condition of being trained enough. Due to created training methodic, it was mentioned, that training environment affects whole training process, so several surveys were made at different environment configurations. The main goal and mission of such approach implementation is using trained agents to develop a system for crowd behavior modeling in the building, which was set on fire.

articleTitle: An method of service composition with optimal resources allocation in software-defined networking
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The work is devoted to developing the complex methods of service composition and provision in Software-Defined Networking. The service provision mechanism in the multiservice network under Software-Defined Networking concept is analyzed. An overview of existing service provision methods that are widely used in distributed computing networks is proposed. The solution of the multicriteria task of services selection and composition with optimal resources allocation are proposed in the work. The model of complex service provision in Software-Defined Networking and algorithm of service composition with optimal resource allocation are also represented.

articleTitle: Experimental research of remote checking system of power supply based on technology of the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the article a model of the monitoring system for electricity consumption is proposed based on the using of Internet of things concept. The scheme of the system and characteristics of its components are presented. The data of experimental studies of monitoring the characteristics of electricity consumption are demonstrated. The results of the researches can be used in the design of monitoring systems of various physical parameters for the purpose of practical implementation of projects based on the Internet of things concept.

articleTitle: Matching elements development method investigation for electromagnetic field parameters conversion under emission launching into optical fibers of different types
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The problem of matching elements development for emission launching intooptical fibers of different types with electromagnetic field parameters conversion for communication line losses reduction is considered. On the base of interferometric testing method the technique for matching section elements geometric characteristics estimation is developed and the method for optical fibers of different types interface definition with special software developed for this purpose is proposed. The experimental investigation of this method is carried by making use of optical fiber interference fringe patterns acquisition unit and developed software for its automatization.

articleTitle: Method for rules set forming of cyber incidents extrapolation in network-centric monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Cyber incidents can disrupt regular mode of information and telecommunication systems functioning and to cause the substantial material and image losses for the company. One of the approaches in incident management is the use of the theory of network-centric management for cyber incidents monitoring, but is not formalized stage of forming basic rules set. In this regard, in this work developed the method for rules set forming of cyber incidents extrapolation in network-centric monitoring, which allows to automate and increase accuracy operation of network-centric systems for information and telecommunication systems monitoring by determining possible types of cyber attacks and cyber incidents categories, forming vector-matrix of cyber incidents probability, cyber incidents ranging by their importance and determining limit values of probability, forming cyber incidents possibility indicators, and also development and establishment of cyber incidents extrapolation rules.

articleTitle: Using non-uniform sampling in real-time correlation processing of authentication signals
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted to the mathematical model and description of the functioning of the multi-correlometer which performs the processing of noise signals in electronic device authentication. It is proposed to use deterministic non-uniform sampling based on irregular pulse sequences with the properties of "no more than one coincidence" and "minimal aperiodicity". This allows eliminating aliasing effect, reducing the sampling frequency and requirements for frequency stability of the analog-to-digital converter.

articleTitle: The art of war in the cyber world
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper focus on cyber weapons used in Advanced Persistent Threat (ATP) attacks in present and future cyber warfare. The combined use of propaganda and cyber warfare supports military operations on the ground and is exemplified with the ongoing Russian hybrid warfare in Ukraine. New models and methods to develop future trustworthy critical infrastructures in our societies are presented. Some mitigation ideas to meet the challenges of future hybrid warfare are also discussed.

articleTitle: Reenterable model of communication grid with cut-through nodes: Performance evaluation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A reenterable model of communication grid with cut-through nodes was constructed in colored Petri nets form. Reenterable model of communication grid consists of reenterable model of grid structure main page, reenterable submodel of nodes, and reenterable submodel of terminal devices. The workload is generated by the terminal devices, attached to the grid border. The grid performance and average packet delivery time were studied for different intensity of Poisson and Uniform distributions. The grid efficiency under regular workload was compared for cut-through nodes for direct and reenterable models for grid structure with different sizes. The reenterable models of the grid structures do not depend on the grid size; it is the main advantage of reenterable model.

articleTitle: Parameter definition of the camera settings and of recognizable object in the system of automatic video recording
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A detailed analysis of the requirements for video surveillance systems and algorithms for character recognition is carried out. In order to obtain correct results, it is necessary that the entire measuring path (Camcorder-Cable-Monitor) be, as far as possible, of minimum length and maximum quality. The measuring table should be evenly illuminated. The shorter the focal length, the stronger the distortion. Therefore cameras with wide-angle lenses (less than 4mm) are undesirable to use. Maximum effect on the depth of field is provided by the lens aperture. The smaller the aperture opening - the greater the depth of field, the more - the smaller the depth of field. All the recommended cameras for recognizing numbers are able to adjust to changing lighting conditions by automatically changing the aperture. It is recommended to adjust the focus of such cameras with the maximum open aperture, when the depth of field is minimal. Most of the existing methods rely on the allocation of license plate boundaries. This fact can be used in additional image analysis. Consider all such problems - this is the task for serious number recognition systems.

articleTitle: Correction of the receiving channels fiber optic transmission systems on the basis of PDM and N-OFDM with decimation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article describes the implementation of optic transmission systems with combined scheme of multiplexing - N-OFDM-PDM, and rapid changes of the signal between OFDM, OFDMA or N-OFDM. To reduce the computational load on the digital segment, it is proposed a distributed digital signal processing low speed digitization with the use of thinning. For correct decoding, the proposed variant of correction of possible imbalance of the polarization channels.

articleTitle: Structural stegdetectors performance in case of side-informed message embedding
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Counteraction against sensitive information leakage with usage of hidden (steganographic) communication channels is topical issue today. Development of advanced side-informed message embedding methods lead to significantly increasing the robustness of formed stego files, in particular stego images, to known steganalysis methods. Providing the high accuracy of stego image detection in such case requires obtaining additional information about precover (higher-quality representation of the cover), which does not available in most cases. For increasing the accuracy of stego image detection there was proposed to use the multilevel image model. Performance analysis of multiclass stegdetector, based on mentioned model, as well as advanced statistical stegdetectors was provided. It was shown that applying the proposed multilevel image model allows significantly decrease the detection time in comparison with known statistical stegdetector by preserving the fixed accuracy of stego image detection.

articleTitle: The justification of the direction for increasing the availability of the video information in objective control systems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the article the process of forming the truncated matrix of the binary frame mask of the segment is considered. An estimation of the presence of single elements in the lines and columns of the segment of the binary mask is made. The principles of compact representation of the truncated matrix of the segment of the binary mask using the code of power of the alphabet are justified, which provide the potential opportunities for an additional increase of the compression ratio.

articleTitle: Cluster coding in system of multilevel selective data processing
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the work multilevel selective data processing with the use of the cluster coding depending on bit stream that is produced approach is proposed. Using the developed adaptive algorithms RLE coding and adaptive essentially arithmetic encoding is proposed.

articleTitle: Determining of the optimal buffer size for online data flow
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: It was suggested a calculation of rational value of package buffering, that grants the probability of system failure do not exceed the set value. It was received the analytic equation and graph of system refuse dependence of package quantity was built. the technology of finding the rational duration of accumulation of packets before the time of their use for the intended purpose, providing with a given probability a continuous mode of operation of the system, is proposed. This technique can be used in software for playing multimedia, such as watching online video movies and music, as well as online TV and radio. Implementation of the developed technology does not require special new equipment or rewriting protocols, and can be easily added as a multimedia player module on the client's computer.

articleTitle: Wavelet analysis of complex nonstationary oscillatory signals
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted to the wavelet analysis in application to the problem of study of complex nonstationary oscillatory signals. Studies were conducted at oscillatory signals arising from different frequencies. Qualitative and quantitative characteristics of the oscillations, features of signals and their differences were found.

articleTitle: Providing of invariance property for piezo resonance devices on the basis of adaptive systems contained predictive standard
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Conceptual regulations related to the development of invariant and multi-frequency piezo resonance devices with controlled dynamics (IPRD/CD) are considered. The control law is formulated for IPRD/CD in real time on the basis of predictive numerical analysis of the system core dynamics. The criterion of optimal control is designed analytically for minimization of energy expenses.

articleTitle: An astimation of the structural survivability of the indetermine structure network on the basis of its structural characteristics
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The method for estimating the structural survivability of telecommunication networks with an indetermine structure on the basis of the index of structural survivability of the networks, which determined using the lower and upper levels of structural survivability, is given in the paper. Formulas for determining the number of routes that can used to service requirements, as well as cross-sections that separate routes, which makes it possible to estimate the structural survivability of networks, are presented.

articleTitle: Comparison of different approaches to determining the mean delay time in a queuing system H2/M/1
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Currently, there are no analytical methods for surely determining the characteristics of queuing systems G/M/1 or G/M/m, and this reflects the degree of adequacy of stochastic network models to real computer and telecommunications networks and the quality of design decisions. This article presents the comparative results presented in various publications devoted to the determination of the average waiting time in queuing systems G/M/1, in particular queuing system with hyper-exponential arriving time.

articleTitle: Construction of the comprehensive multi-layer graph model of the search spaces associated with the combinatorial optimization problems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article presents the original model of the search spaces associated with the combinatorial optimization problems.
