The proposed model is characterized by the enhanced descriptive potential allowing to evaluate the reasonableness of applying the different techniques for finding the optimal solutions. With a view to forming the theoretical background required for formalizing such model, the article introduces the mathematical apparatus of the multi-layer graphs. In addition, the article constructs the concrete example of the model for the instance of the traveling salesman problem.

articleTitle: Development of analytical CRM — the system of assesment of solvency of borrowers of commercial bank
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the system under development, the creditworthiness of the potential borrower of the bank is evaluated, taking into account the data from alternative sources and the choice of the cross-product of the bank offered to the client as an additional to the requested one, algorithms based on the Bayes formula are used. To build optimal algorithms for the choice of cross-products, it is planned to extend the mathematical model in accordance with the theory of probability criteria, which will allow to ensure maximum information productivity.

articleTitle: A method of network monitoring with reduced measured data
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The task of reducing operational data produced by network monitoring is relevant. This task is the more important the bigger quantity of network nodes is monitored. A method, which helps to reduce monitoring operational data, is proposed. It involves reducing the set of measured variables and the number of measurement moments. The method focuses on using WBEM\CIM repositories and WMI technologies. The examples for the method are considered.

articleTitle: Quality of service for multimedia conte delivery in infocommunication networks based on xDSL technology
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Current time is characterized by the rapid development of technology for the delivery of audiovisual information through infocommunication networks based on IP-protocol. One of the technologies that can deliver IPTV signals is technology based on xDSL. In this regard, task on conducting an analysis of the IPTV signal distribution system based on xDSL technologies, the methods of measuring and monitoring of the characteristics, and based on the results of the study to assess the impact of distortions in the xDSL path on the quality of IPTV services is arising. As result of studies the estimations of parameters for quality of service metrics during transmission of multimedia content via infocommunication network based on xDSL technology. Relative graphical results and numerical data are presented.

articleTitle: The method of constructing the randomness extractor of a quantum random number generator on the basis of multimodulo transformation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In general form the problem of synthesis and analysis of an extractor algorithm with an alphabet base of more than two based on multimodulo transformation for a prospective quantum random number generator (QRNG) is formulated and solved. This work was carried out as part of a comprehensive theoretical and experimental research to create a prototype QRNG based on the implementation of the method of double radio-resonance in alkali metal vapors.

articleTitle: Searching optimization method for requested media data in peer-to-peer network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The processes of request, search, selection and delivery of video content in peer-to-peer networks with the unstructured architecture, which is most consistent with heterogeneous and dynamic Internet environment, are considered. The problem solution of files fragmentation requested by the consumer in a P2P network of streaming video using a discrete-continuous mathematical autoregressive model is used, which displays the state of each j-th peers on each of the k-steps of fragmentation. The solution of the problem is reduced to the procedure of dynamic programming. In selection of m-proposed fragments, it is recommended to select two, which will help to reduce the service traffic.

articleTitle: Morden attacks analysis for NTRU-similar algorithms
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The analysis of attacks on NTRU-similar algorithms is given. Conclusion about lattice-based cryptography security is derived.

articleTitle: Mobile operators base station subsystem optimization method
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The declared requirements to networks of the fourth generation aren't reached none of the realized networks. That shows low level that testifies to a low performance of the existing planning methods of radio networks, transport subsystems and methods of management. Therefore, in this work base stations subsystem optimization method of mobile network operator was developed which consists in sequential determination of optimum structure of a subsystem, taking into account restrictions on quality of service, the admissible frequency band, the number of the active subscribers, use of multistandard active antenna systems and programmatically configured radio interface. The offered method allows to increase the radius of zones of service of subscribers of cellular networks up to 80%.

articleTitle: NTRU similar algorithm optimization for asymmetric encryption with the «overstretched parameters»
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Researched a new class of parameters such as NTRU algorithm with optimized basic algorithmic operations. The results obtained with regard to the performance for the NTRU method with the modified parameters were compared with the speed characteristics of the NTRU implementation of the method with the standardized parameters.

articleTitle: Access neuro-fuzzy controller for W-CDMA networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper proposes to apply a neuro-fuzzy controller in telecommunication networks for call admission control enabling congestion avoidance in W-CDMA networks. A structure of the neuro-fuzzy controller has been proposed. Input and output linguistic variables, their terms as well as membership functions have been developed. Also, a rule base of the controller has been suggested. Functioning of the neuro-fuzzy controller has been simulated and trained.

articleTitle: Laboratory model communication systems with a frequency hopping
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this article the main principles of building radiostation with frequency hopping spread spectrum are described. This problem is relevant because of modern powerful facilities for electronic intelligence and jamming. The laboratory model of the modern frequency hopping spread spectrum radiostation with quadrature radio frequency processing was developed.

articleTitle: Non-line-of-sight channel modeling for millimeter wave mobile communications with diffracted and reflected rays
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper analyzes the model of the millimeter-wave channel budget, taking into account the peculiarities of narrow-beam antenna radiation. It is proposed to calculate the gain factor for the line-of-sight and non-line-of-sight channels in urban environments due to diffraction and reflection. A multi-beam model is proposed that determines the total gain and loss of the millimeter wave channel, which is the result of diffraction, reflection, absorption, excess of the path of the rays, divergence of the rays. The developed analytical multi-beam model can be used in the design of millimeter-wave mobile systems for the urban scenario, which will significantly improve energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Interval method traffic analysis in multiservice communication systems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Article is devoted to the new method of the analysis of queues in systems of multiservice with flows of requests of a general view called "interval". The kidney flows of packets characteristic of modern multiservice communication networks are considered. It is offered, as the analyzed random variable to use numbers of the requests arriving during intervals of servicing of each request. The concept of differential intensity of a flow of requests is entered and shown that the average of requests on an interval of servicing doesn't depend on the distribution law of a flow. The algorithm of consecutive determination of average length of a queue, with flows of requests of a general view is considered, and on its basis the balance equation for instant values of queues is received. Based on the balance equation, the ratio generalizing the known formula Pollaczek-Khinchin is received any flows of requests. The formula is suitable for determination of average values of queues of systems of mass servicing, with any flows of requests. It is shown that the denominator of the generalized formula doesn't depend on a type of the analyzed flow and is determined only by values of load factor of system. The private examples confirming justice of the received generalized formula are reviewed. It is shown that for kidney flows of packets of multiservice networks the determining impact on the extent of queues is exerted by correlation properties of flows.

articleTitle: Principles of construction of applied cybernetic systems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The general principles of modeling and application of cybernetic systems are considered in the article. An overall description of the automated monitoring and control systems of various complex objects is given. Uncertainty of the object of control was estimated. An overall assessment of the effectiveness of automated monitoring and control systems based on a comparison of the potential and real systems was conducted there.

articleTitle: The evaluation method of coding efficiency of basic frames of the video stream in infocommunication
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Relevance of the questions connected to improvement of quality of provision of specific images with using of aeromonitoring. Need of enhancement of technologies of coding of a video stream is justified. Creation of a method for an assessment of algorithmic complexity for a method of processing of basic frames on the basis of diagonal-uneven positional coding of transformants in nonequilibrium base of the bases will be organized. Feature of the created technology from a position of algorithmic implementation as is that diagonals have non-uniform length, quantity of discharges on codegrams are selected by diagonal non-uniform principle. Is shown that complexity of algorithmic implementation of the developed method of compression of basic frames is in the linear dependence from the frame size and generally is defined by the number of operations falling on execution of two-dimensional cosine transformation. The carried-out comparative assessment showed prospects of the created method on the basis of diagonal-uneven positional coding of transformants concerning its algorithmic complexity.

articleTitle: Investigation basic characteristic operation of cloud data center
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article presents a computer model of a cloud data center. Each cluster is an exponential queueing system with expectation. The main characteristic among the indicators of the cloud data center is the performance. Performance refers to response time of the system. The dependence of the mean response time on probability of requests to the data center and on number of virtual machines in the cluster was investigated based on developed model.

articleTitle: Optimum error-correction codes design based on the combinatorial configurations
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper deals with design of correcting data binary code using mathematical properties of the combinatorial configurations for optimizing of coding systems with respect to error protection, while maintaining on code length. These properties make combinatorial techniques useful to development of the info-communication systems with active redundancy and minimization of algorithmic process complexity. Combinatorial configurations such as cyclic difference sets and “Ideal Ring Bundles” are well applicable for error-correcting design.

articleTitle: Modeling adaptive communication system with MIMO and OFDM
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The mathematical model adaptive communication system using MIMO and OFDM technologies with adaptation not only in the time domain but also in the frequency domain is considered in the work. Using of the Kalman filtering algorithm is analyzed to track changes in the channel matrix and its estimation by minimizing the noise effects. The simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of the multiservice communication network's node as a arbitrary type queuing system
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Analysis of the characteristics of network nodes using a numerical method is considered in the article. An algorithm for determining the mean waiting time and buffer size for a network node, represented as a queuing system G/G/1 has been worked out. The obtained values are confirmed by the results of the simulation model implemented in Matlab system. The results of the algorithm and the previous known analytical results are compared.

articleTitle: Classification of admissible transient functions in infocommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of the algorithm for the identification of quantized transitional functions admissibility in infocommunication systems on the basis of models constructed by using support vector machine methodology.

articleTitle: An analysis of the waiting time for the M/G/1 system while processing a correlated traffic
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this work, the behavior of G/G/1 system in the processing of traffic with high autocorrelation has been studied. As an approximation, it is proposed to use the H2 distribution. As a result, an analytical evaluation of the waiting time of the packet in the queue has been obtained. The result is verified using simulation modeling.

Author Keywords: waiting time of the application in the queue

articleTitle: Selection of error measure for discrete periodic signals at high levels of fluctuating noise
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article covers the selection of an error measure for the results of Altering discrete noisy periodic signals when searching for optimal parameter values of the digital low-pass filter represented by the "simple moving average". The following error measures were selected for comparison - Mean Square Error, Root Mean Square Error, Mean Absolute Error. To perform the experiments, a program generation of sinusoidal, triangular, square and sawtooth periodic waveforms was implemented. A series of experiments was carried out for generation and filtering of the noisy periodic signals with different noise levels. Values of error measures were found for filtered signals with different values of the digital filter parameter. Experimentally shown that at high noise levels the local minima of the objective functions are gradually transformed into straight lines and then into a monotonically increasing ones. Using the kurtosis measure the error measure was selected based on comparison results, representing the high-discernibility of local optima of the objective function at high levels of fluctuating noise.

articleTitle: Music signal processing to obtain its chorded representation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper we present a research of methods of music audio signals processing intended to present them in chord notation. A program was developed to implement such processing with a high precision of chords distinction using Fourier transforms.

articleTitle: Deep analysis of the data of a telecommunications company to identify abnormal customers
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this article we consider an approach of analysis the telecommunications company customers information using data mining technology. The purpose of this work is to develop a software solution for identifying customers who behave abnormally compared to ordinary customers. To solve the problem the method of cluster analysis is used, with k-means, method of support vector machines (SVM) and non-standard method of initializing k-means++ centroids. With the use of developed software, we analyse the obtained data and identify the customers who are suspected in abnormal behavior. To classify the new data the classifier is developed, which is trained on large data sets and based on SVM. The scientific value of the work is in the application and adaptation of well-proven methods of intellectual analysis for solving such a complex task for the TC. The practical value of the developed and trained classifier is that it can be replicated for use in other companies.

Author Keywords: the method of initializing k-means++ centroids

articleTitle: Hidden process detection for windows operating systems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Rootkits detecting in the Windows operating system is an important part of information security monitoring and audit system. Methods of hided process detection were analyzed. The software is developed which implements the four methods of hidden process detection in a user mode (PID based method, the descriptor based method, system call based method, opened windows based method) to use in the monitoring and audit systems.

articleTitle: Thermography testing of telecommunication facilities temperature conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The application of advanced infrared techniques for various communications-electronics equipment diagnostics is considered. The descriptions of the developed thermographic testing procedures for diverse units of telecommunication facilities are cited.

articleTitle: Efficiency analysis of microwave infocommunication systems for access to multimedia/interactive services
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Microwave infocommunication multimedia radio systems in frequency band below 10 GHz are allowing to get access to audiovisual information (Digital television, Video on Demand, etc.), other types of information for group and individual users (wireless Internet access, interactive applications). There are many variants of implementation of such systems (that also referred as Microwave Multipoint Distribution infocommunication System (MMDS)), each of which has its own characteristics and performance. In this regard, task on conducting study of different variants of the implementation of the microwave infocommunication system is existing. The results of the studies of the current status of the development of multimedia delivery technologies based on MMDS standards are provided. Performance of different variants of MMDS system is estimated. The directions of further development of these technologies are proposed.

articleTitle: Monitoring and telecommunications subsystems integration in the wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The problem of constructing a control system by non-uniform wireless sensor sensors (WSN) is considered. A new paradigm for constructing of a control system for wireless sensor network is proposed - subsystem of coordination and integration of functions monitoring and telecommunications subsystem introduced.

articleTitle: Data sources for the complex use information ERP-system of corporate SME
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Article reviews technological embodiments of formation and data transmission for the information ERP-system of a SME focused on the integrated use by autonomous companies (customers), which are part of the corporation, are considered. ERP-logic formalized data is available to authorized customers of the information ERP-system in B2B/FMCG modes from the mobile terminal and/or in the "mobile client" mode to meet certain information needs. The technological embodiments realize the possibility of obtaining remote data through the server for an information ERP system when the remote data terminal equipment (DTE) (sensors) form the BAN (BAN/PAN) info-communication network in accordance with the Wireless PAN class telecommunication technology or coupled with the subscriber terminals of the MAN class mobile telecommunication network.

articleTitle: Experimental research of the deterministic chaos oscillator based on a bipolar transistor structure with negative differential resistance
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper presents results of experimental researching the deterministic chaos oscillator for application in telecommunication systems. The oscillator active element is a bipolar transistor structure with I-V curve of N-type. At different supply voltages, the oscillator operates in oscillatory, chaotic and relaxation modes. Phase portraits and oscillograms of the oscillator output voltage have been experimentally examined in all modes.

articleTitle: Method of message coding, using ortogonal chaotic signals in secure information telecommunication networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper proposes a method of message coding using orthogonal chaotic signals obtained by a Modified Discrete Chaotic Map Based on Chebyshev Polynomial and the Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization procedure. The proposed method allows to increase the speed of data transmission in secure information telecommunication networks.

articleTitle: Combining different image parts of instruments with image mosaicing
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this study, the different image parts belonging to one instrument are combined to obtain a high-resolution and full-bodied image as a whole. Images of different sizes that represent different regions of the same instrument are properly combined to obtain a full representation of the instrument. First, properties of images are obtained by using the histogram of gradient (HOG) features. Then, features similar to those obtained features are searched in other images. For this, the obtained properties are applied using convolution in all image. The regions having the highest convolution value are selected as junction regions. There are two problems in the image combining process. These are: the dimensions of the instrument parts in the images may be different, and the location where these parts are located may not overlap. An approach for automatic image sliding and automatic scale synchronization has been proposed for these problems. Finally, the merged pixels of the resulting image are softened. So, the contrast differences between the images due to the light is minimized. The proposed method was tested using different instruments in experiments. Successful results have been achieved for all compelling test images.

articleTitle: Code-based public-key cryptosystems for the post-quantum period
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Code-Based Public-Key Cryptosystems were been considered in this work. In addition, the current state, the existing contradictions and prospects of practical use for the post-quantum period were been studied. The authors have proposed new scheme of crypto-transformation that significantly exceeds the relative speed of information transmission. An advantage of the proposed scheme compared with the well known the McEliece and Niederreiter schemes has shown.

articleTitle: Technology analysis for smart home implementation
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Smart home has become more and more popular in recent years. Smart homes filled with connected things are loaded with possibilities to make our lives easier, more convenient, and more comfortable. This paper provides technology analysis for smart home implementation. It also includes description of technologies, applied for implementation of smart homes in the past. All these technologies were relevant and competitive within the contemporary networks, but they are not able to satisfy modern requirements. This paper also concentrates on the concept of internet of things. This is a new trend, which is experiencing active development. In this paper, the problems of the internet of things concept implementation have been done.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of the IPv6 implementation in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Implementation of IPv6 is spreading across the globe and network professionals are put in the spotlight as this new protocol is added to their organization's network infrastructure. This paper represents the peculiarities of the IPv6 implementation in Ukraine.

articleTitle: Placement problems in chip design: Modeling and optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A new approach to modeling placement constraints in VLSI design is presented. For that, concepts of circular-like and similar shape objects are introduced. A number of mathematical models for optimization of different phases of a chip design closure are proposed: a die size minimization, the total wire length optimization, a chip unit cost minimization. All known so far chip shapes - squares, octagons, and rectangles - are used as placement objects. The models are formulated as continuous optimization, regardless a presence of discrete variables. A continuous representation approach to the analytical description of discrete sets is used as a tool for the equivalent reformulation.

articleTitle: Calculation of expense for local computer networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Different concepts of local computer network technological scheme and its economic justification with some appropriate calculations have been shown in this article. In our article, we are using our proposed approach, which can be helpful for some different companies, which is engaging to projecting and cabling the local computer networks. With using of this presented approach, these companies or other specialists in this area will be able to optimize their own costs more than 40% from full costs, which are planned for structured cabling design in data centres, and apartment buildings for data or voice communications using various kinds of cables. Our approach based on some standard costs varieties for the structured cabling design, which can be recommended to using only half part from cable possibility (wired cable). Therefore, full number of conductors in wired cable with the help of addition devices (splitters) was been offered to use. At the same time, any main functional characteristics of this wired cable were not being changed. In additional, is not any necessary to changing or re-building the rooms, hall-way's, passages and other kind of premises with using our approach, because this approach suggested to directly modify communication channels near the computer devices.

articleTitle: Differential electromagnetic attack on cryptographies modules of a quantum random number generator
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper describes a differential electromagnetic analysis (DEMA) attack that is performed on a software implementation of the AES-128 in cryptographic modulo (extractor) of quantum random number generator (QRNG). A DEMA attack on an improved extractor implementation demonstrates that for correlation analysis it is required series of measurements to find the key bits. The metric of attack success is determined by the number of measurements needed to intercept the round keys. An efficient way to perform the correlation between theoretical predictions and real measurements it is the usage of the "F-tests".

articleTitle: Methods of semantic proximity extraction between the lexical units in infocommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper presents one of the ways solution to the problem of lexical ambiguity: the using methods of extraction and analysis of semantic relations between lexical units. The proposed methods are divided into groups, among which identified and discussed the most popular. As well, special attention is paid to the methods of k-nearest neighbor and mutual k-nearest neighbor, which allow to introduce the problem of extracting semantic proximity as one of the classification tasks.

articleTitle: The method of pseudorandom codes decoding on the basis of the modified method of branches and boundaries
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Constructive mathematical method of decoding the pseudorandom code based on the use of branch and bound method are considered. Modification of the classical algorithm of branch and bound is proposed, assessment of computing complexity of pseudorandom codes decoding methods Program implementation of method of decoding of pseudorandom codes is developed.

Author Keywords: modified method of branches and boundaries

articleTitle: An integrated approach to cloud data center resource management
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The complexity of cloud data centers requires advanced resource management solutions that are capable to adapt to the changing customer's demands while providing continuous service and performance guarantees. The proposed Integrated Resource Management approach for energy-aware resource management provides the necessary elasticity on the physical machine level by considering a data center power consumption and a service-level agreement violation. The Integrated Resource Management approach is based on the data center state-space dynamic model, power consumption model, prediction model, SLA violation model, and capacity planning model method. The modeling process takes into consideration heterogenous environment, virtualized resource granularity, virtual machine live migration power consumption, virtual machines on/off state, and virtual machine deployment delay. The analysis and simulation, using Google cluster-usage traces, show that using Integrated Resource Management approach cloud service providers can achieve energy savings while minimizing SLA violations in terms of the number of overloaded physical machines and VM deployment delay.

articleTitle: Decomposition-compensation approach with adaptive scheduling
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Software-defined IT infrastructure does not have a clear definition in modern science world. There are many different interpretations among the corporate definitions of a software-defined IT-infrastructure, each of which is surely possible. General representation of software-defined IT-infrastructure was proposed based on those corporate interpretations. To solve the management problem in software-defined IT infrastructure the base management model was introduced. The base management model consists of three management loops namely outer, inner and operational loops. An analysis of several existing methods for service level management was conducted. Among the methods, which were considered in the paper, there are the use of management system with coordinator, injection of neural network into management subsystem, the use of a genetic algorithm, etc. The management system model and method for service level management, which is used in proposed management system, were developed basing on conducted overview of management methods and defined term of software-defined IT infrastructure. The method for management of software-defined IT infrastructure uses algorithm, which consists of three steps that can be executed separately or consequently. Those steps are reorganization of tasks, coordination of tasks according to IT infrastructure characteristics and adaptive planning, which is conducted based on actual data about IT infrastructure functioning. In order to study the efficiency of the proposed method the modelling with CloudSim was performed. Results of work were used in the management system of IT-infrastructure, which is named Smartbase ITS Control.

articleTitle: Means of countering threats in communication systems of broker companies
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The manuscript considers the means of information technologies that allow solving the problem of counteraction to external threats caused by the use of communication systems in the activity of broker companies. Identified the main types of threats that inherent in brokerage activities in modern conditions. It was shown that the rapid growth of the level of these threats is generated by the high dynamism and instability of the global economy as a whole and the financial industry in particular, by the uncontrollable development of the means and organizational forms of cyber-crooks in the global information networks, and using of computer communication systems to provide work of brokers is the most important condition for the implementation of these threats. The analysis of technical tools offered by manufacturers to protect information systems and ensure effective trading activity in the financial markets in modern conditions, on the basis of which the composition of the system of means of protection of communication systems and activity of broker companies was offered.

articleTitle: Methods of data sample metrics evaluation based on fractal dimension for computational intelligence model buiding
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The problem of subsample selection for the model building on the precedents is addressed in the paper. The sequential and parallel methods of data sample metrics evaluation are proposed. They are based on the principles of fractal dimension and allow to characterize sample properties important for classification. The developed methods have been implemented in software and used for solving the problems of classification.

articleTitle: New steps of image quality enhancement and evaluation in video applications
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper presents results of authors' studies in the field of image quality in light of new technologies of image capturing, production, processing, delivery and reproduction in TV and related video applications. With coming era of UHDTV, HDR-TV and 3D-TV the approaches for image rendition quality are being changed together with progress of video technology and with changing image viewing conditions at the transmission and repro-duction ends of light-to-light video chain. There are the proposals for the use to assess color ren-dition fidelity of colorimetric models covering of color ap-pearance conditions in the traditional luminance range, for which models of photopic mechanism of color vision are functioning, in the luminance range of glares corresponding to the model of perception of unrelated colors, as well as in the luminance range in the area corresponding to the mesopic and scotopic perception model. It is proposed to build the test materials and assessment criteria, which would allow to give a separate estimate for the three mentioned are-as. Estimations of color appearance metric for traditional dynamic range systems are get. The tasks for more complete evaluation of color fidelity, taking into account the mentioned problems, are set. Estimates of the relative color gamut area with consideration of color appearance model are made. Examples of constructing sets of colors, uniformly filling a region of colors transmit-ted by TV systems, are provided. The issues of the possible use new types of systems, adaptive to the properties of transmitted scenes and conditions of image perception at the transmitting, receiving sides and at intermediate points of video path are discussed. Ar-guments for the use of image quality evaluation methods in view of adaptability are provided. The problem of implementation object-oriented approach to the transmission scenes in the case of the mesh presentation natural objects model is considered. An example of the mesh representation scene is shown. The comparative eval-uation of the efficiency mesh representation and presentation in the traditional media still image compression systems of objects is given. The problem of image quality in the case of a com-pressed image representation using wavelet analysis techniques is considered. The example of assessment for possi-ble compression methods using a variety of approaches to its implementation is given.
